impact: Phase 3.5 spec (sections 2-3, 9) requires a dated task's priority to auto-assign from its due date and auto-climb as the date nears. Verified during T-008 review: DateBandEngine.resolveBand is called in exactly one place, AddTaskSheetV2.resolvedPriority (task creation). BoardProjection groups by the stored priorityOptionId and never re-derives priority from the due date. TwoAxisPolicy.evaluateDateChange (the only DateBandConfig consumer) has NO call site. So: (1) date mutations after creation (snoozeToDate, promoteBrainDumpWithDate, removeDateAndMoveManual) do not recompute priority from bands; (2) existing dated tasks do not climb as their date nears (no day-rollover reprojection); (3) changing the configurable bands (T-008) does not re-place already-created tasks. Fix: move date-to-priority resolution into a core use case / write-service operation that accepts DateBandConfig and resolves the PriorityKey through the stored mapping, route every due-date mutation through it, and add rollover/boundary-change reconciliation. Out of scope for T-006/T-008/T-009 (which only expose and use the bands at creation); tracked here so Phase 3.5 sign-off accounts for it.
title: Dated priorities are not self-managing across all date paths
